contexts.text: He began to be inwardly tortured, and... cast himself thence into Hell.
Cast (thy rod) on the earth () = the influx of the power of the Lord's Divine Natural into the Sensual... To cast, or let go = what proceeds, thus influx.
To cast them to the earth () = to destroy. AC 10071:end. AR 541.
Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh () = the power which is shown... To cast before Pharaoh = to show. AC 7295. AC 7298.
The horse and his rider hath He cast into the sea () = that at His mere presence falsities of evil are damned and cast into Hell. AC 8275. AC 8343.
He cast (the wood) into the waters () = with which he affected truths.
To cast the tables out of his hand, and break them () = to destroy the genuine external sense...
Rude projections... WH 11:4.

The Angel took a censer and filled it with the fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth () = spiritual love, in which there is celestial love, and its influx into lower things, where there were those who were in faith separated from charity.
That great dragon was cast forth () = those who are meant by the dragon, turned away from the Lord to themselves, and from Heaven to the world.
He was cast forth into the earth, and his angels were cast forth with him () = into the World of Spirits...
When the dragon saw that he was cast forth into the earth () = that the dragonists, after their casting down into the World of Spirits...
Under Cast down, see this reference.
Cast him out and throw his clothes after him.
I threw myself flat on the ground.
(To cast into the earth = total vastation.)
(To cast it to the earth = complete destruction.) 403[6]. AE 727:3.
To be cast forth ()-to be damned.
Be thou cast into the sea () = to be cast down into Hell, whence they come.
Thou art cast forth out of thy grave () = that it is damned to Hell.
He cast them to the earth () = the extinction and destruction of them.

That great dragon was cast forth, that old serpent = that there are separated from Heaven and cast down into Hell those who are in evils of life, and thus have become sensuous... To be cast forth, when said of the dragon, = to be separated from Heaven, and cast down into Hell.

He was cast forth into the earth, and his angels were cast forth with him = that these evils and falsities were condemned to Hell. To be cast forth into the earth = to be separated from Heaven and condemned to Hell. Explained. AE 746.
When the dragon saw that he was cast forth into the earth = when the religion of faith alone separated from the life of charity was not acknowledged, but was held cheap. Explained.
